label: Modal Trigger
description: Turns the first element in a small HTML fragment into an open, close or toggle control for a Modal.

properties.name: component_name
properties.label: Component name
properties.help: Use this name with a <tvi-component> marker when the trigger is a reusable root component.

properties.name: modal_node_id
properties.label: Modal fallback
properties.help: Optional fallback. A connected Modal target port takes priority.

properties.name: html
properties.label: Trigger HTML
properties.help: The click action is attached to the first HTML element. A button is used when no valid element is supplied.
